semiconductor_relevance: High — Esmo Asia Pte. Ltd. specializes in handling and automation systems, manipulators, and docking/interfacing solutions specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Esmo Asia Pte. Ltd. is a leading supplier of handling and automation systems, manipulators, and docking/interfacing solutions for the semiconductor industry. They provide tailored solutions for integrating test head manipulators and docking systems into test cells, enhancing efficiency and performance for semiconductor manufacturers.

regional_presence.Germany: Esmo Asia is part of the esmo Group, which is headquartered in Germany and known for high-standard engineering technology.
regional_presence.United States: Esmo has a presence in the United States to support its global customer base.
regional_presence.Singapore: Esmo Asia operates in Singapore, providing services and products tailored to the local semiconductor market.
regional_presence.Taiwan: Esmo Taiwan Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary that offers a full range of products and services in the region.
regional_presence.China: Esmo has operations in China to cater to the growing semiconductor industry there.
regional_presence.India: Esmo serves leading semiconductor players in India, including Infineon and TI.
